subject: general
question: It is Elephanta Festival' of ______________ named after the Elephanta Caves.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maharashtra.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Elephanta Festival is celebrated in February every year on **Elephanta islands in Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• The caves, as well as the island, were given the name **Elephanta** by Portuguese invaders after they took control of the place in 1534. 
 
• **It was the discovery of a gigantic rock-cut sculpture of an elephant on the island that prompted them to name the place so**.
 
• The **'City of Caves**', on an island in the Sea of Oman close to Bombay, contains **a collection of rock art linked to the cult of Shiva**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Edakkal Cave**s Located at about 1200 ft above sea level, the Edakkal Caves are among the oldest human settlements ever discovered.
 
• **Junagadh Caves** are located in **Gujrat.**
 
• **Caves Located in Madhya Pradesh:**__
 
 
• ​Bhimbetka Caves , Raisen.
 
• Adamgarh Caves, Hoshangabad. 
 
• Saru Maru Caves, Sehore. 
 
• Pandav Caves, Pachmarhi.
